inlines.v: SPEAR, noun 1. A long pointed weapon, used in war and hunting by thrusting or throwing; a lance. 2. A sharp pointed instrument with barbs; used for stabbing fish and other animals. 3. A shoot, as of grass; usually spire. SPEAR, verb transitive To pierce with a spear; to kill with a spear; as, to spear a fish. SPEAR, verb intransitive To shoot into a long stem. [See Spire.]
